title: NX Shortcut Workbench
summary: Browse an NX command catalogue, inspect command identifiers and work with shortcut assignments from an imported role. Additional views help arrange keyboard references, keycap printing, macropad output and a side launcher. Editing here does not automatically change the active Siemens NX session.
features: Find commands, filter by installed-module grouping and show assignments or UI controls.
Import an .mtx role before editing assignments; export the resulting role for NX.
Save an editing draft and undo changes in the workbench.
Review assignments spatially on a keyboard.
Prepare reference/key-label output and supported macro-pad data.
Review launcher options and the documented catalogue sources.
workflows: Type a name such as Extrude into Search all commands. Review both the displayed label and command identifier: similarly named commands can belong to different workflows.
Use category and installed-module filters to narrow results. Include UI controls only when you intend to inspect those entries too.
Open a command’s details before assigning it. Catalogue presence does not prove that your NX installation licences that command.
Edit a role without losing the original
Export or copy your existing NX role first. Choose Import role and select its .mtx file. Assignment editing and Export role remain disabled until a role is available.
Make one assignment change, review any conflict information and use Undo change if it is not what you intended. Save a draft while working.
Export the edited role under a new filename, then import/test it through NX’s normal role workflow. Keep the original until you have verified the result.
Open Keyboard Map to inspect where assignments sit rather than reviewing only a table.
Use Keycap Print for physical labels/reference output and Macropad Export for the supported target format. Check the destination device/application requirements before importing it.
Side Launcher is a separate convenience view; browser output does not itself demonstrate successful command execution inside NX. Read Help and sources for catalogue assumptions.
limits: The included catalogue references NX 2412. Other versions/modules and macro hardware need testing. Siemens catalogue/icon assets require rights review before public distribution; the repository remains private.
